blocks.prompt: 8. Find a joint equation of the lines through the origin and perpendicular to the lines \(3x^{2} + 5xy - 2y^{2} = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein lines ka ek jora diya hai aur humein ek NAYA jora banana hai.
Naye jore ki har line origin se guzre aur di gayi lines mein se kisi ek par perpendicular ho.
Rule: perpendicular lines ke slopes ka product \(-1\), yani naya slope purane ka 'ulta aur sign badla' (negative reciprocal).
Plan: di gayi lines alag karna, un ke slopes, naye slopes, nayi lines \(y = mx\), aur aakhir mein dono ko multiply kar ke joint equation.
steps:
Diya gaya: lines \(3x^{2} + 5xy - 2y^{2} = 0\).
Maloom karna: origin se guzarne wali un lines ki joint equation jo in par perpendicular hon.
Tareeqa: factorize kar ke di gayi lines; perpendicular slopes ke liye \(m \cdot m' = -1\); origin se guzarne wali line \(y = m'x\); aur joint equation = dono equations ka product.

Di gayi equation factorize karein
\[3x^{2} + 6xy - xy - 2y^{2} = 0\]
\[3x(x + 2y) - y(x + 2y) = 0\]
\[(3x - y)(x + 2y) = 0\]
Kyun: aise numbers chahiye jin ka product \(3 \times (-2) = -6\) aur jama 5 ho: woh 6 aur \(-1\) hain.

Di gayi lines ke slopes
\[3x - y = 0:\; m_{1} = 3\]
\[x + 2y = 0:\; m_{2} = -\dfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: har line ko \(y = mx\) ki shakal mein likha: \(y = 3x\) aur \(y = -\frac{1}{2}x\); \(x\) ka coefficient hi slope hai.

Origin se perpendicular lines
\[m = -\dfrac{1}{3}:\; y = -\dfrac{1}{3}x \Rightarrow x + 3y = 0\]
\[m = 2:\; y = 2x \Rightarrow 2x - y = 0\]
Kyun: perpendicular slope = negative reciprocal. 3 ka ulta \(1/3\), sign badla to \(-1/3\). Aur \(-1/2\) ka ulta \(-2\), sign badla to \(2\). Fractions hata kar lines saaf likh di.
Dhyan dein: sirf sign badalna ya sirf ulta karna kaafi nahi; dono kaam karne hain.

Multiply kar ke joint equation
\[(x + 3y)(2x - y) = 0\]
\[2x^{2} - xy + 6xy - 3y^{2} = 0\]
\[2x^{2} + 5xy - 3y^{2} = 0\]
Kyun: do lines ki joint equation un ki equations ka product hoti hai (Section 5.8). Beech ke \(-xy\) aur \(6xy\) jama ho kar \(5xy\).

Tasdeeq:
\[\text{Di gayi: } a = 3,\; 2h = 5,\; b = -2\]
\[\text{Nayi: } bx^{2} - 2hxy + ay^{2} = -2x^{2} - 5xy + 3y^{2}\]
Kyun: \(-1\) se multiply karein to \(2x^{2} + 5xy - 3y^{2} = 0\) \(\checkmark\). Yeh shortcut hamesha chalta hai: \(ax^{2} + 2hxy + by^{2} = 0\) par origin se perpendicular lines \(bx^{2} - 2hxy + ay^{2} = 0\) hoti hain, yani \(a\) aur \(b\) jagah badal lein aur beech wale ka sign badal dein. Answer key bhi yahi deti hai.
